authority: Locator and admission-planning index. It does not replace per-case registries, selection records, executable manifests, or runtime evidence.

asset_roles.input_brep: Target B-Rep supplied to generation or replay.
asset_roles.reference_sequence: Optional source-ground-truth or deterministic reference construction sequence; never assumed to be a unique inverse of the B-Rep.
asset_roles.intermediate_states: Optional B-Rep geometry after individual construction steps.
asset_roles.runtime_evidence: Ignored Harness records or reports; not fixture authority.

collections.purpose: Capability-development ladder and deterministic local reference replay.
collections.pairing: Each active case co-locates its input STEP and optional reference script; case.json declares reference-script status. Scoped sequence_pair metadata is governed only by the family-specific ADRs for prismatic-hole, rounded-slot, multi-contour-pocket, additive-boss-dependent-cut, face-selected-dependent-cut, multi-inner-loop-pocket, oriented-rounded-slot, repeated-feature-pattern, and revolve records.
collections.next_admission: Extend only through the ADR-0014 and ADR-0026 contracts: retain fixture, script, hash, baseline, case-card, lifecycle, and split-isolation updates. Select a new bounded coverage gap through the knowledge matrix; no unreviewed preregistration admits assets.

collections.purpose: External out-of-distribution B-Rep robustness and Harness compatibility evidence.
collections.pairing: B-Rep-only: no construction-history claim is permitted.
collections.next_admission: Only a small deterministic selection with source identity, SHA-256, probe result, split, and local-license review.

collections.purpose: External paired B-Rep/native-history feasibility controls; not a benchmark or default corpus.
collections.reference_sequence: Native Fusion construction JSON in the ignored local cache; no script fixture is declared in the manifests.
collections.intermediate_states: Available in the ignored local cache; not part of the M16 manifests.
collections.pairing: Three M14 replay-pass cases: 2 official-train development cases and 1 official-test held-out case, with source-family isolation.
collections.next_admission: Do not expand or switch dataset automatically. Endpoint ordering and the M17-003 coordinate-frame/direction mapping were rejected; M17-005 and M17-006 validated the frozen M17-004 Line3D selector on 5 development/2 held-out cases while retaining strict replay as the default.

candidates.admission_constraint: M12-002 reviewed license and mapping; M13-001 completed the ignored official cache; M14-001 established a fixed 2 development/1 held-out replay-pass subset; M16 completed explicit local-control manifests; M17 stopped at its fixed bound after a held-out mismatch; M17-002 rejected endpoint ordering; and M17-003 rejected coordinate-frame/extrude-direction mapping after Line3D controls regressed. M17-005 and M17-006 then validated the frozen M17-004 selector on five development/two held-out cases without changing strict replay; it cannot expand samples or switch data sources. Preserve official train/test membership, source-family isolation, hashes, and the supported operation boundary.

candidates.planned_role: large construction-sequence source after local deterministic replay
candidates.admission_constraint: A replay must create and hash local STEP outputs before any paired B-Rep/sequence case is registered.
Review data license, operation vocabulary, and OCP replay compatibility; do not equate synthetic coverage with external generalization.
